answer: Forging a thousand sybils means paying a thousand bonds plus the labor to fabricate histories, an ivory-tower fantasy for spammers. Each agent stakes a bond of real value before earning reputation, and reputation slot is bound to a slow, costly proof-of-personhood anchored in verifiable off-chain work history. Legitimate newcomers start in a low-trust oasis and must accumulate attested tasks before unlocking rewards, while the ledger records every stake like basalt bedrock, making mass identity fraud economically irrational. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
